ignore-id.PKSA-d5tc-s1qs-h781: CVE-2026-102279, XSS in the debug error page. Only reachable with APP_DEBUG=true; production runs with it off. Fixed in Laravel 12.69 / 13.30.
ignore-id.PKSA-m5cs-t1y6-qpcs: Temporary signed URL path confusion. The app creates and verifies no signed URLs (no signed routes, no `signed` middleware, no package that uses them). Fixed in Laravel 12.61.1 / 13.12.
ignore-id.PKSA-3r5d-mb8f-1qw9: CRLF injection through the `email` validation rule. Mitigated in-app: BB\Validators\CustomValidator::validateEmail() rejects CR/LF for every `email` rule (tests/unit/Validators/EmailCrlfValidationTest). Fixed in Laravel 12.60 / 13.10.
ignore-id.PKSA-mdq4-51ck-6kdq: CVE-2026-48019 (the 9.x-12.x entry for the same issue as PKSA-3r5d-mb8f-1qw9): CRLF injection through the `email` validation rule. Mitigated in-app: BB\Validators\CustomValidator::validateEmail() rejects CR/LF for every `email` rule (tests/unit/Validators/EmailCrlfValidationTest).
ignore-id.PKSA-zwc5-qtrz-zm1n: CVE-2026-48019 again, as filed against the illuminate/mail split package. It isn't installed (laravel/framework provides it), but laravel-notification-channels/telegram requires illuminate/notifications, and Composer won't resolve that chain without this ignore. Same in-app mitigation as PKSA-3r5d-mb8f-1qw9: BB\Validators\CustomValidator::validateEmail() rejects CR/LF for every `email` rule.
